note_en: 无论…还是…，都… means "no matter whether… or…, (it) all…": 无论是肉片、蔬菜，还是豆腐，都要自己放进锅里涮熟 "whether it's sliced meat, vegetables, or tofu, you cook it all yourself in the pot." Unlike English "whatever," 无论 needs 都 in the main clause, and the text uses it again with a question phrase: 无论风格如何变化 "however the style changes."
